mutations.name: the headline is the last labelled line, not the stored reading
kills: the owner-at-head evidence card heads a decorated weakened line before a canonical unchanged one with the stored reading, listing both lines

mutations.name: the verdict text is not checked against the stored reading
kills: the owner-at-head evidence card reads missing when the verdict text no longer reads as the stored CI-policy reading

mutations.name: the marker is compared after dropping names that are not known rows
mutations.replace: import { ownerAtHeadRowsIn as ownerAtHeadNamesIn, type OwnerAtHeadRow } from "../owner-at-head.js";
kills: the owner-at-head evidence card reads missing when the gate's marker names a fact the evidence does not hold, an unknown one included

mutations.name: an evidence re-read after the gate opened is taken as its evidence
kills: the owner-at-head evidence card shows the evidence the gate opened on, not a re-read that completed after it

mutations.name: the CI-policy files come from GitHub's compare list instead of the evidence's changed paths
kills: the owner-at-head evidence card shows a renamed workflow's old path as deleted, since the evidence lists both sides of the rename
